phases.title: Foundations of the Christian life
phases.description: Finish the core of the faith before the long walk through Scripture: grace, who God is, who Jesus is, sin and forgiveness, faith and repentance, the Holy Spirit, prayer, Scripture, the church, godly manhood, marriage, fatherhood, baptism, the Lord's Supper, worship, giving, sharing your faith, spiritual warfare, identity in Christ, holiness, love, forgiveness, spiritual gifts, and living hope. Lessons 1–13 are already complete (October 31–November 12, 2026). Lessons 14–30 close the foundations, beginning with the Lord's Supper on November 13.

phases.title: A walk through all 66 books of the Bible
phases.description: A BibleProject- and Thru the Word-style survey of every book, in Protestant canonical order. Major books receive about a week; shorter books receive one to three days. Each day has a focused title and real NIV passages so you can read the heart of the book without stalling. Sundays still advance the walk, but they are flagged as sermon-tie-in days, with that day's book lesson as the fallback if you want a planned reading after church.

phases.title: Marriage: covenant, duties, and intimacy
phases.description: A deeper run for husbands and wives: God's design, leaving and cleaving, the duties of husband and wife, mutual honor, the holiness and joy of the marriage bed, honest speech, conflict, forgiveness, praying together, purity, repairing trust, and cherishing one another for a lifetime. The women's version of each lesson keeps the same passages and emphasizes the wife's calling alongside the husband's.

phases.title: Parenting: discipling the next generation
phases.description: Go deeper than the first fatherhood lesson: teach diligently at home, discipline in love, family worship, example, prayer, prodigals, protecting and preparing your children, blessing them on purpose, and trusting the Father who runs to meet them.

phases.title: Money: stewardship, debt, and generosity
phases.description: God owns it all; you are a steward. This run faces debt head-on (including Proverbs 22:7, 'the borrower is slave to the lender'), contentment, greed, honest work and honest scales, saving without hoarding, providing for your household, open hands toward the poor, cheerful generosity, and treasure in heaven.

phases.title: Work: vocation, excellence, and rest
phases.description: Work was God's idea before the fall. These lessons cover labor as worship, integrity when no one is watching, skill and excellence, sloth, justice for workers, witness on the job, Sabbath rest, thorns and frustration, and vocational faithfulness over a lifetime.

phases.title: Character: the fruit of a life in Christ
phases.description: Close the year with the fruit of the Spirit and the marks of a mature life: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control, humility, courage, integrity, a tamed tongue, truth-telling, compassion, perseverance, and abiding in Christ. Lesson 365, on October 30, 2027, looks back on a year of grace and looks ahead: he who began a good work will carry it on.
